sentences.text:
In Re: Sanjib Pal  ...Pet  Mr. M. Mukherjee,
 Ms. Gargi Goswami,
 Mr. S. Mukherjee,
 Ms. S. Banerjee.

.... For the Pet  1.
Heard the submission.

The instant revisional application has been filed for quashing of the entire proceeding in connection with the ACGR 1112 of 2020 arising out of Garfa Police Station Case No. 123 of 2020 dated 13.03.2020 under Section 498A/406/307/506 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Garfa Police Station Case No. 123 of 2020
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. At the outset it is submitted by the learned Advocate that the case started under the aforesaid provision but the charge-sheet has been submitted under Section 498A/406/307/506 of the Indian Penal Code as no document was produced by the de-facto complainant to attract Section 307 IPC.

3. The point raised regarding maintainability of the subsequent complaint in the year 1998 lodged by the complainant with similar nature of allegation and the same was withdrawn on account of settlement arrived between the parties.
4.
Hence, an arguable case has been made out before this Court for which the matter is required to be heard.
5. In view of the above, the instant revisional application is admitted.
6. The petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the opposite party.
7. The matter to appear as contested application four weeks hence before the regular bench.

8. Let there be stayed all further proceeding till 30th April, 2026 or until further order whichever is earlier.

All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Chaitali Chatterjee (Das), J.)
